children: RNS Number : 8797U  Nationwide Building Society  15 September 2026
Notification of Admission to trading of Transferable Securities
15 September 2026
Nationwide Building Society*

The following transferrable securities issued by Nationwide Building Society (the "Society") have today (15 September 2026) been admitted to trading on the main market of the London Stock Exchange plc:
·     NOK 380,000,000 5.150 per cent. Fixed Rate Senior Preferred Notes due September 2036 (ISIN: XS3506267601) (the "Notes").

The Notes are issued under the Society's U.S.$35,000,000,000 European Note Programme (the "Programme") pursuant to the Base Prospectus dated 30 July 2026 (the "Base Prospectus") and the Final Terms dated 11 September 2026 relating to the Notes (the "Final Terms").
Full information on the Society and the offer of the Notes is only available on the basis of the Base Prospectus, read together with the Final Terms.

The Base Prospectus and Final Terms have been published on the website of the London Stock Exchange through a regulatory information service (http://www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/news/market-news/market-news-home.html). The Base Prospectus is available and the Final Terms will be available on the website of the Issuer at  https://www.nationwide.co.uk/investor-relations/gmtn-terms-of-access/.
